question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.reason: Should repeat customers be counted using all recorded orders, or only completed/delivered orders? I would define a repeat customer as a customer with at least two qualifying orders within the same half-year.
